name: aidememoire
title: aidememoire
blurb: enter your handle and someone you've blocked — it pulls the real block record, downloads what they were posting around that moment plus years of your own posts, cross-references the likes/replies/reposts between the two accounts, and files a case explaining why, via a local keyword classifier, not AI. quoted from a queued idea calling for exactly that ("a cool AI-assisted aide memoire") and tagged into being by @nequals001.bsky.social.
